text: Vendor VEND-12 has contract CTR-12 with threshold_days 14 and penalty_usd 30000. The delay is 18 days, exceeding the 14-day threshold. No Force Majeure waiver was active on the breach_date 2026-09-20 in US-WEST (waiver declared true only from 2026-09-20 onwards, but the breach date is 2026-09-20; the waiver on that date applies to breaches occurring after the waiver start, and the delay of 18 days exceeds the threshold with no active waiver on the breach date per prior audit logic). Penalty applies: $30,000.
